Messages.Author: kyuudaime
Messages.Body:
if I have 2 in the pool and I make a card that costs 2, should I go back to play without the costs paid or do I just lose the game?
after all, if the player was turned off and didn't realize he was going to die, can he accidentally kill himself in the game?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> kyuudaime wrote:
> if I have 2 in the pool and I make a card that costs 2, should I go back to play without the costs paid or do I just lose the game?
> after all, if the player was turned off and didn't realize he was going to die, can he accidentally kill himself in the game?
>
Bad play and illegal play are different things.

Announcing that the card costs 0 or 1 (which is illegal), playing it, and then realize that it costs in fact more is illegal from the start -- thus it must be rewound.

Playing the card without making any false announcement and then genuinely realize that it ousts you is bad play -- but not illegal. It must not be rewound.

Playing the card because you want to self-oust instead of PTW is illegal, and should be rewound.

Messages.Body:

> > after all, if the player was turned off and didn't realize he was going to die, can he accidentally kill himself in the game?

> Playing the card because you want to self-oust instead of PTW is illegal, and should be rewound.
>
> groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/cNAXynUBHLs/m/P6_7Q9yHXJMJ
>
Unless self-ousting gives you more chances of winning the game: e.g. you give 1 VP and 6 pool for a player to stay alive till time limit and you have already 2 VPs, hence giving you the game win.

And the other situation is: you cannot do more than 0 in the game so you can maximize your VPs as you want.
